name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-vulns
description: Known vulnerabilities in your projects. Choose a project folder: MnemoVulns reads its lockfile (pnpm-lock.yaml or package-lock.json), asks OSV.dev which installed versions have a known vulnerability, and shows each one with the version that fixes it. Each advisory is kept in your knowledge folder and in a memory pack with its source, its licence and its date, and every vulnerability is tracked from one scan to the next: open, fixed, or a risk you accepted with your reason.

descriptionI18n.fr: Les failles connues de tes projets. Choisis le dossier d'un projet : MnemoVulns lit son lockfile (pnpm-lock.yaml ou package-lock.json), demande à OSV.dev quelles versions installées ont une faille connue, et montre chacune avec la version qui la corrige. Chaque fiche est rangée dans ton dossier des connaissances et dans un pack de mémoire avec sa source, sa licence et sa date, et chaque faille est suivie d'un scan à l'autre : ouverte, corrigée, ou un risque que tu as accepté avec ta raison.
descriptionI18n.es: Las vulnerabilidades conocidas de tus proyectos. Elige la carpeta de un proyecto: MnemoVulns lee su lockfile (pnpm-lock.yaml o package-lock.json), pregunta a OSV.dev qué versiones instaladas tienen una vulnerabilidad conocida y muestra cada una con la versión que la corrige. Cada ficha se guarda en tu carpeta de conocimientos y en un paquete de memoria con su fuente, su licencia y su fecha, y cada vulnerabilidad se sigue de un análisis a otro: abierta, corregida o un riesgo que aceptaste con tu motivo.

agentActions.summary: The projects MnemoVulns watches: name, folder, the summary of the last scan (open vulnerabilities by severity, what to fix first), and whether one is being scanned.
agentActions.details: lastScan is null for a project never scanned. A summary written by an older version may lack openBySeverity or toFix: absent, never 0.

agentActions.summary: The known vulnerabilities of one project from its last scan: advisory id, package, installed version, severity, the version that fixes it, and its tracking state (open, accepted with the reason, fixed).
agentActions.details: The last scan is read when the project is open: NOT_LOADED says to call openProject first. state defaults to open. Reading changes nothing on screen: to show the person, openProject, filterPackages or showPackage.

project.description: The project as the person says it (its name, or words of it) or its folder; default the project on screen.

package.description: Only this package, as the person says it (« lodash », « babel core »).

agentActions.summary: Show one project's page on the person's screen, as a click on its tile does.

project.description: The project as the person says it (its name, or words of it) or its folder.

agentActions.summary: Go back to MnemoVulns's home (the list of projects).
Show one vulnerable package on the project page: its tile scrolled into view and opened, as the person's click on it does.
agentActions.details: Opens the project first when another page is on screen. A filter that hides the tile is set back to all. A malicious package heads the page in its own section. Answers its open count, worst severity and the version that fixes it.

project.description: The project as the person says it (its name, or words of it) or its folder; default the project on screen.

package.description: The package, as the person says it (« lodash », « babel core »).

agentActions.summary: Filter the project page's packages as its chips do: all, shipped (in the product), dev (development only), unknown (the lockfile does not say).
agentActions.details: unknown exists only when some package's place is not stated (NO_FILTER otherwise).

project.description: The project as the person says it (its name, or words of it) or its folder; default the project on screen.

agentActions.summary: Scan a project now: read its lockfile, ask OSV.dev (or the local database) which installed versions are vulnerable, keep the records and update the tracking.
agentActions.details: Opens the project and answers started at once: a scan can take minutes. Call projects until scanning is false, then vulnerabilities. One scan at a time (BUSY).

project.description: The project as the person says it (its name, or words of it) or its folder; default the project on screen.

agentActions.summary: Stop the scan that is running, as its Stop button does.
agentActions.details: Answers stopped once the scan has ended, or stopping (follow with projects). NOT_SCANNING when none runs.

agentActions.summary: Choose where scans look vulnerabilities up, as the base buttons of the home do: local (the database downloaded on this machine) or online (OSV.dev).
agentActions.details: Only once a local database is installed (NO_LOCAL_DATABASE). Not during a scan (BUSY).

agentActions.summary: Accept the risk of one open vulnerability, with the reason, as the person's Accept button does. It stops counting as open.
agentActions.details: The package alone names the risk when it has one open vulnerability; several are refused with their ids (AMBIGUOUS): pass id. ecosystem only when the same pair is in two ecosystems. On WRITE_FAILED, read vulnerabilities before retrying: the tracker may already say accepted.

project.description: The project as the person says it (its name, or words of it) or its folder; default the project on screen.

id.description: The advisory id (GHSA-..., CVE-..., MAL-...), only when the package has several.

package.description: The package, as the person says it (« lodash », « babel core »).

ecosystem.description: The ecosystem (npm, PyPI...), only when needed.

reason.description: Why the risk is accepted; kept with it.

agentActions.summary: Take an accepted risk back: the vulnerability is open again.

package.description: The package, as the person says it (« lodash », « babel core »).

agentActions.details: The package alone names it when it has one accepted risk; several are refused with their ids (AMBIGUOUS): pass id.

agentGuide: Name a project or a package the way the person says it (« le projet site », « lodash », « babel core »): MnemoVulns finds it by its words. Several matches are refused with their names (AMBIGUOUS): pick one and call again.
With no project named, the project on screen is meant.
To look at something: openProject for a project's page, showPackage for one package, filterPackages for the chips (shipped, dev, all), home for the list of projects.
scan takes minutes: it answers started, then call projects until scanning is false. stopScan stops it.
A risk is named by its package; the advisory id only when the package has several.
